description: Free. Sets your vault's target allocation across the 4 stocks in basis points (sum 10000), e.g. [4000, 3000, 2000, 1000]. Default is equal weight. Returns an UNSIGNED transaction {to, data, value, chainId} on Base; nothing happens until you sign it with your own wallet and broadcast it. Liquid never holds keys or funds.

weightsBps.description: 4 weights in basis points summing to 10000, in the basket's constituent order (see stocks_basket).

steps.description: When two transactions are needed (approve, then deposit), sign and send them in order
